elements.text:
Action / owner / timing	Experiment or learning method	Evidence and acceptance
L1 Protected experiments
Squad lead; from week 2	Reserve 10% of pilot time. Log a hypothesis, baseline, bounded staging test, success rule and stop rule.	One recorded experiment every 2 weeks; retain unsuccessful results and decisions.
L2 No-blame review
Ops + Test; from week 3	Review incidents and near misses within 2 working days. Use a timeline and contributing system factors.	Publish review; assign actions and dates; close only after a test or runbook change.
L3 Shared learning
Dev/Test leads; from week 3	Pair across roles; weekly 30-minute demo; shared wiki; monthly community meeting across all teams.	Show a lesson reused by another team; rotate demo ownership and maintain an index.

elements.text: Resilience drills begin in staging only, with a named supervisor and an immediate stop/restore procedure.
